posts.text: Current CEO Chris Paul is very supportive of this leadership change. It shows he is always looking for the best solution to bring this new copper district forward. I applaud and thank him for this. He understands his strength is in the field, kicking rocks. What he has achieved in the last few years is truly remarkable. George Ogilvie as the incoming CEO (together with his team) is a ‘match made in heaven’ for Hercules 🙏 This is one for the history books. Glad to be part of it, (since the ‘discovery hole’ a few years back) #discoveryinvesting
